title.value: From Precision Medicine to Precision Convergence for Multilevel Resilience—The Aging Brain and Its Social Isolation
title.justification: The chosen title is the exact title provided at the beginning of the document, clearly indicating the focus on precision convergence, multilevel resilience, and social isolation, particularly in the aging population.
title.quote: From Precision Medicine to Precision Convergence for Multilevel Resilience—The Aging Brain and Its Social Isolation

extractions.description: This paper discusses the concept of precision convergence, an approach that extends beyond precision medicine to integrate societal, technological, and individual factors to achieve multilevel resilience. It particularly focuses on the aging population and the social isolation they face, proposing a framework to enhance adaptive real-world behavior in response to environmental challenges, especially during and after the COVID-19 pandemic.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is the concept of precision convergence in health systems, with a focus on aging and social isolation. While it touches on systemic and societal transformation for resilience, it doesn't explicitly focus on climate or ecological sustainability as a central theme.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this Opinion, we argue that lessons from the COVID-19 vaccine response can inform our approach to other equally pressing health emergencies worldwide, such as the epidemic of loneliness in older adults.

secondary_categories.quote: Precision Convergence is an integrative governance framework that embeds ethical, social and privacy concerns into science, technology, innovation, and policy.

primary_sub_category.quote: Precision convergence extends and bridges the scientifically defined multi-scale mechanisms in biology and neuroscience on the one hand and social systems impacting real-world behavior, on the other.

secondary_sub_categories.quote: Resilience refers to 'the capacity of a system to tolerate disturbances while retaining its structure and function.'

applications.value: Addressing social isolation in the aging population through precision convergence
applications.justification: The paper suggests a precision convergence approach to tackle social isolation among the elderly, highlighting potential applications in enhancing societal and individual resilience.
applications.quote: We use social isolation among seniors as an exemplar, or test case, of how and why a precision convergence approach is necessary to potentiate transformative change.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on using precision convergence to enhance resilience in health systems and address social isolation, which does not fit neatly into existing Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories.
new_primary_category.quote: We argue that lessons from the COVID-19 vaccine response can inform our approach to other equally pressing health emergencies worldwide, such as the epidemic of loneliness in older adults.

new_primary_sub_category.value: Social Isolation and Healthcare System Resilience
new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper deals with the integration of various scientific and social approaches to enhance resilience and manage social isolation, especially in the context of aging populations.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We propose precision convergence as an approach to achieve this level of synergy in finding societal-scale real-world solutions for a resilient and healthier future, with health and healthcare systems at its core.
